checks.name: 01_create_two_disposable_identity_sets
checks.detail: Two independent disposable QA identity sets created with distinct run scopes.

checks.name: 02_login_two_independent_owners
checks.detail: Owner A and Owner B authenticated in separate cookie jars.

checks.name: 03_create_two_isolated_tenants
checks.detail: Two distinct disposable businesses created under different owners.

checks.name: 04_each_owner_can_read_only_own_runtime
checks.detail: Each owner resolves their own tenant normally.

checks.name: 05_owner_a_cannot_read_tenant_b_runtime
checks.detail: Foreign business id is neutralized to NO_TENANT_SELECTED with no Tenant B business or membership data.

checks.name: 06_owner_b_cannot_read_tenant_a_runtime
checks.detail: Reverse foreign tenant read is neutralized with no Tenant A data leakage.

checks.name: 07_own_whatsapp_status_is_tenant_scoped
checks.detail: Each owner can resolve only their own tenant WhatsApp state; no global identity is inherited.

checks.name: 08_owner_a_whatsapp_tenant_b_denied
checks.detail: Owner A is denied before Tenant B WhatsApp connection metadata can be loaded.

checks.name: 09_owner_b_whatsapp_tenant_a_denied
checks.detail: Reverse WhatsApp cross-tenant access is denied without WABA/phone leakage.

checks.name: 10_owner_a_service_catalog_tenant_b_read_denied
checks.detail: Owner A cannot enumerate Tenant B services.

checks.name: 11_owner_b_service_catalog_tenant_a_read_denied
checks.detail: Owner B cannot enumerate Tenant A services.

checks.name: 12_owner_a_service_catalog_tenant_b_write_denied
checks.detail: Owner A cannot create or mutate a service inside Tenant B.

checks.name: 13_owner_b_service_catalog_tenant_a_write_denied
checks.detail: Owner B cannot create or mutate a service inside Tenant A.
